# Vendored: Astryx neutral theme

- Source: https://github.com/meta/astryx — `@astryxdesign/theme-neutral@0.4.1`
- File: `theme.css` (generated by `astryx theme build`)
- Licence: MIT (see the upstream repository `LICENSE`)
- Fetched: 2026-11-20

Kept verbatim. It defines design tokens (colour, spacing, radius, shadow,
typography) inside `@scope ([data-astryx-theme="neutral"])` and resolves light
and dark through CSS `light-dark()`, so the panel needs no second palette block.

Do not edit this file. To upgrade, fetch the new version from jsDelivr and bump
the version note above:

```
curl -sL "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@astryxdesign/theme-neutral@<version>/dist/theme.css" -o vendor/astryx/theme.css
```

Component CSS from `@astryxdesign/core` is intentionally not vendored: the
panel is vanilla JS, so only the token layer is used. The panel's component
styles are written against these tokens and follow Astryx conventions (soft
elevation, hairline borders, `--radius-*` scale, `--font-size-*` ramp).
